crop.notes: The left edge of the column is cut off throughout (first letters of most lines missing) and the headline 'Here They Are, A Goodly Crew of Old Prizefighters' and deck are cut on the right; the byline (J. B. Sheridan) is cut. The article continues in a second column not in the clipping. Both Allen mentions are inside the clipping.

ocr.notes: Gist readable but many errors from the cut left edge ('Tom Adlen', 'inkee Sullivan', 'Guss').

title.suggested: Roundup of Old Prizefighters Lists Tom Allen Among the Dead

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Post-Dispatch, in a survey of old prizefighters, listed Tom Allen and Joe Goss among those who had died, and named Allen among the fighters known to Prof. Bill Clark of St. Louis.

metadata.notes: Masthead: Sunday Morning, St. Louis Post-Dispatch, November 12, 1905, page 10. The current title ('Goss and Allen Match Arrangements') and summary do not describe the article.

notes: Only passing mentions of Allen (as dead, and in a list of fighters Bill Clark knew); no new facts about his life.
